title: sqlgen configuration
description: Shape of a sqlgen.yml configuration file. Editor hinting only: this schema checks structure, key names and closed value sets. It cannot express sqlgen's cross-field rules (driver/dialect pairing, required connection, soft-delete column type compatibility, cursor-key existence) — run `sqlgen validate` for those.

version.description: Config schema version, for forward compatibility.

exclude_tables.description: Glob patterns for tables to drop from generation entirely, for file and introspection inputs alike. `*` matches any sequence, `?` any single character; case-sensitive.

tables.description: Per-table customization, keyed by table name (bare or schema-qualified).

views.description: Per-view customization, keyed by view name.

enums.description: Per-enum customization, keyed by SQL enum name (bare or schema-qualified).

extras.description: Custom struct definitions, typically to give a JSONB column a typed Go shape.

operations.description: An `api.operations` mask: which operations the generated API exposes. Either a preset name or an explicit key map. The Go client has no such switch — it generates every method the schema allows — so this narrows exposure only.

operationsObject.description: Explicit mask keys, optionally layered on a base preset. Each key names the client method its API surface calls. The client-only keys are declared only to be rejected.

connection.description: The `<table>s` cursor query, backed by Connection.

update_where.description: The `update<Table>s(filter, input)` mutation, backed by UpdateWhere. Also gates the O2M / has-one nested relink verbs into this table.

upsert.description: The `upsert<Table>` mutation, backed by Upsert. Needs a conflict target.

create_with_related.description: The `create<Table>WithRelated` mutation. Requires `create` in the same mask. Emits nothing unless generation.nested_mutations enables the family and the table has an eligible relationship.

update_with_related.description: The `update<Table>WithRelated` mutation. Requires `update` in the same mask; same gating as create_with_related.

upsert_with_related.description: The `upsert<Table>WithRelated` mutation. Requires `upsert` in the same mask; same gating as create_with_related.

soft_delete.description: The soft-delete mutation. Only takes effect when a soft-delete column is detected.

restore.description: The `restore<Table>` mutation. Only takes effect when a soft-delete column is detected.

get_many.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1). `<table>List` is backed by Paginate and gated on `paginate`.

update_many.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1). `update<Table>s` is backed by UpdateWhere and gated on `update_where`.

upsert_many.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1).

exists.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1).

count.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1).

increment.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1). Increments reach the API as `_inc` / `_dec` operators on the update input.

stream.description: Rejected: names a client method no API surface calls (PRD §26.5.1).

input.description: Where the schema is read from.

dialect.description: SQL dialect used for parsing. Note: `postgres`, not `postgresql`.

schema.description: PostgreSQL only: the schema an unqualified table name or `REFERENCES` target resolves to. `*` resolves to `public`. It does not filter which schemas are parsed. Ignored with a warning on MySQL/SQLite.

paths.description: SQL files or directories to parse, when source is `files` or `both`.

views.description: Paths to view annotation files or directories. Parsed only as views, never as DDL.

parse_mode.description: How duplicate table definitions across files are handled.

connection.description: Database connection. Overridden by the SQLGEN_DB_URL and SQLGEN_DB_PASSWORD environment variables, which take highest precedence.

url.description: Full connection URL. Takes precedence over the individual fields.

host.description: Required for postgres/mysql when `url` is empty.

port.description: Required for postgres/mysql when `url` is empty.

user.description: Required for postgres/mysql when `url` is empty.

database.description: Database name, or the file path for SQLite.

ssl_mode.description: TLS/SSL mode. Defaults to `disable` on postgres, `false` on mysql.

introspect.description: Schema and table filtering applied during database introspection.

schemas.description: Schemas to include. Empty means all non-system schemas.

exclude_schemas.description: Schemas to exclude. Applied after inclusion.

tables.description: Tables to include. Empty means all in the selected schemas.

driver.description: Go database driver the generated code imports. `pgx` is only compatible with `dialect: postgres`.

dir.description: Default output directory for all artifacts.

package.description: Default Go package name. Derived from `dir` when omitted.

fileOutput.description: Override the output location for a generated artifact.

file.description: Output filename. Always resolved relative to output.dir — an absolute path is re-rooted under it, not honored.

package.description: Go package name. Defaults to output.package.

generation.description: Global generation defaults. Six of these can be overridden per-table under `tables.<name>`: query_limit, batch_size, page_size, cursor_keys, exclude_columns and strict_updates. The rest are global-only.

query_limit.description: Default LIMIT for GetMany when none is given.

batch_size.description: Rows per batch in CreateMany / UpdateMany / DeleteMany.

cursor_keys.description: Columns used to encode keyset-pagination cursors.

uuid_version.description: UUID strategy for app-generated UUID primary keys. v4 random, v7 time-ordered.

strict_updates.description: When true, Update and Increment return ErrNotFound for a missing PK. When false they are idempotent.

exclude_deleted.description: Exclude soft-deleted rows from reads by default.

soft_delete_columns.description: Soft-delete columns to detect. Detection runs in list order.

update_columns.description: Columns stamped with the current timestamp on update.

exclude_columns.description: Columns excluded across all tables. Merged with any per-table list.

operations.description: Removed: the Go client generates every method the schema allows (PRD §4.6). Use api.operations to control what the API exposes.

nestedMutations.description: Opt-in nested mutations — the three ...WithRelated methods. Off by default: with enabled unset or false, no nested method, wrapper input type or nested GraphQL mutation is emitted anywhere in the package.

enabled.description: Master switch. Nothing nested is emitted unless true.

operations.description: Which nested families to emit. The upsert family also needs a conflict target on the table.

verbs.description: Which verbs may appear in a nested block. A verb omitted here is absent from every generated block, on top of the per-edge eligibility rules, which can only narrow it further.

max_depth.description: Nesting depth. 1 is the only accepted value in v1; the field exists so a future depth is a config change rather than a breaking default.

softDeleteColumn.description: A soft-delete column and the value convention it uses.

type.description: Value convention. timestamp -> CURRENT_TIMESTAMP/NULL, bool -> TRUE/FALSE, integer -> 1/0.

manifest.description: Opt-in machine-readable description of the generated package.

enabled.description: Nothing manifest-related is emitted unless true.

formats.description: Artifacts to emit. At least one is required when enabled.

json_layout.description: single writes one document with inline entities; per_entity writes an index plus one file per entity.

json_per_entity_dir.description: Directory for per-entity JSON, used when json_layout is per_entity.

include_examples.description: Include usage examples in the emitted markdown.

include_internal.description: Include internal-only detail in the manifest.

embed_in_client.description: Embed the manifest into the generated Client via manifest_embed_gen.go.

breadcrumbs.description: Agent breadcrumb files emitted alongside the generated package.

mcp.description: MCP server wiring emitted alongside the manifest.

emit_project_config.description: Emit an MCP project config file.

server_key.description: Server key used in the emitted MCP config.

command_template.description: Command template used in the emitted MCP config.

use_pointers.description: Use *T for nullable columns instead of sql.Null* types.

types.description: Per-SQL-type override, keyed by SQL type name (uuid, numeric, ...).

typeOverride.description: Map a SQL type to a Go type. The type must implement sql.Scanner and driver.Valuer, or be one the driver special-cases (uuid.UUID); wrap a type that does neither in one of your own that does. `import` is omitted for builtin Go types (string, int64, ...), same-package types, and built-in literals that resolve their own import (time.Time, json.RawMessage, types.JSON); it is REQUIRED whenever `type` names any other package, or the generated file would reference a package nothing imports. Under a `tenancy.type` block the rule is stricter still: setting `type` always requires `import`.

zero_value.description: Zero-value literal. Derived automatically; set only when derivation is wrong.

nullableVariant.description: Nullable variant of the type. Shorthand is a bare type name sharing the parent's import; the full form is an object.

oneOf.description: Nullable type name, sharing the parent's import path.

import.description: Import path. Needed when it differs from the parent type's, OR when the parent needed none — a builtin or same-package parent has no import for the nullable variant to inherit, so {type: string, nullable: sql.NullString} must spell nullable.import: database/sql in the full form.

underlying_field.description: Embedded scalar field on the wrapper, e.g. UUID for uuid.NullUUID. Required for foreign-key stringification when the wrapper has no String() method.

valid_field.description: Bool field signalling validity. Defaults to Valid. Mutually exclusive with valid_method.

valid_method.description: Method returning a validity bool, e.g. IsValid. Mutually exclusive with valid_field.

valid_invert.description: Negate valid_method, for methods that signal invalidity such as time.Time.IsZero.

table.description: Per-table customization. Generation fields here override the global `generation` block.

struct_name.description: Override the generated Go struct name.

description.description: Go doc comment on the generated struct. Takes precedence over a SQL COMMENT ON TABLE.

primary_key.description: Override primary-key detection and generation strategy.

strategy.description: db = database generates it, app = the client mints it, caller = supplied in the create input.

uuid_version.description: UUID strategy when the PK is an app-generated UUID.

columns.description: Explicit PK columns, for schemas where detection cannot infer them.

relationships.description: Explicitly declared relationships, beyond those detected from foreign keys.

column_map.description: Per-column overrides, keyed by SQL column name.

type_map.description: Per-column Go type override, keyed by SQL column name.

enabled.description: Override global event publishing for this table.

api.description: Override this table's exposure on the generated API surface.

enabled.description: Tri-state: omit to inherit the global api.enabled.

operations.description: Removed: the Go client generates every method the schema allows (PRD §4.6). Use api.operations to control what the API exposes.

name.description: Go field name for the relationship.

side.description: Which side of the edge this entry describes. Defaults to parent, the foreign-key holder.

fk.description: Foreign-key column that creates the link. Required for o2o and o2m; m2m links through its junction instead.

junction.description: Junction table that links the two. Required for m2m.

junction_local_fk.description: Junction column pointing at this table.

junction_reference_fk.description: Junction column pointing at the target table.

filter.description: Additional SQL predicate applied when loading. Raw SQL, so not invertible — a `filter:` edge is readable but never write-eligible for nested mutations. Mutually exclusive with `discriminator`. Write bare identifiers and single-quoted values (entity_type = 'asset.primary'): on MySQL a double-quoted token is a string literal, not an identifier, so "entity_type" = 'asset.primary' compares two constants and matches no rows — quote MySQL identifiers with backticks. Rejected at codegen on MySQL.

sort.description: Default ordering applied by the O2M / M2M loader when the caller passes no Sorts. Rejected on an o2o relationship, which is loaded by a LEFT JOIN in the parent query.

description.description: Go doc comment on the generated field.

relationshipDiscriminator.description: Structured form of a polymorphic predicate: one column on the related table equal to one value. Compiles to the same equality predicate the equivalent `filter:` produced, and is the only polymorphic form nested mutations can write. Mutually exclusive with `filter`.

column.description: Discriminator column on the related table. Must exist there.

value.description: The value identifying this edge. Bound as a parameter on every read path that can carry one, and interpolated into the O2O JOIN ON clause, which cannot; written verbatim into the column by a nested create.

tableNestedMutations.description: Per-table nested-mutation settings. Inert unless generation.nested_mutations.enabled is true.

relationships.description: Explicit allowlist of edges. Omit it to include every eligible edge. When present, only the listed edges are reachable, and a listed edge that fails an eligibility rule is a hard error rather than a silent omission.

name.description: The relationship's resolved Go field name, as it appears on the entity struct.

allow_reparent.description: Lets an O2M connect on this edge adopt a row already parented elsewhere. With the default, such a row is ErrAlreadyRelated.

name.description: Override the Go field name. Must be a valid exported Go identifier. Renames only the Go identifier — db/json tags, SQL column constants, GraphQL field names and sort enums stay derived from the SQL column name.

description.description: Go doc comment on the generated field.

import.description: Import path for the Go type.

access.description: Access role constraining which external surfaces the value escapes through (generated API, event payloads, manifest). Never affects the core Go client.

struct_name.description: Override the generated Go struct name.

sql.description: Inline view SQL, as an alternative to an annotation file.

invalidate_on.description: Tables whose mutations invalidate this view's cached reads.

cursor_keys.description: Cursor keys for this view. When set explicitly every column must exist on the view. Views have no primary key, so there is no PK fallback.

api.description: Override this view's exposure on the generated API surface. Opt-out only.

enabled.description: Tri-state: omit to inherit the global api.enabled.

entityCache.description: Per-entity cache override. Omit a field to inherit the global value.

entityTenancy.description: Per-entity tenancy override. Omit a field to inherit the global value.

column.description: Tenant column name, when it differs from the global default.

struct_name.description: Override the generated Go type name. Defaults to the PascalCased SQL enum name.

description.description: Go doc comment on the generated type. Takes precedence over a SQL COMMENT ON TYPE.

extraType.description: A custom struct definition, typically for a JSONB column.

description.description: Go doc comment on the generated struct.

fields.description: Struct fields, keyed by field name.

import.description: Import path for the Go type.

tags.description: Struct tags, keyed by tag name.

operations.description: Mask on which operations the API exposes, across every table. Subtractive only: an operation the schema does not give the client can never be exposed.

package.description: Go package name for the generated graph package.

max_depth.description: Maximum query depth accepted by the generated gate.

max_complexity.description: Maximum query complexity accepted by the generated gate.

field_casing.description: Casing for generated GraphQL field names.

gqlgen_config.description: Path to the consumer-owned gqlgen.yml. It stays consumer-owned; sqlgen merges its own mappings in memory.

scalars.description: Custom scalar bindings, keyed by GraphQL scalar name.

go_type.description: Go type bound to the scalar.

marshaling.description: How the scalar marshals. external requires marshaler_package.

marshaler_package.description: Import path declaring Marshal<Scalar>/Unmarshal<Scalar>. Required when marshaling is external, rejected otherwise.

version.description: Cache key version. Bump to invalidate every key at once.

circuit_breaker.description: Trips the cache out of the read path after repeated backend failures.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failures before the breaker opens.

probe_interval.description: Go duration string between half-open probes.

events.description: Mutation lifecycle events. Disabled unless present.

tenancy.description: Mandatory tenant scoping. Disabled unless present.

column.description: Tenant column name used for detection across tables.

required.description: When true, a missing tenant is an error rather than an unscoped query.
